hypothesis: The original implementation used an incorrect iterative loop to calculate the final dimension index, which failed to correctly map the remaining unidimensional index to the last dimension's coordinate.
prediction: Replacing the incorrect while-loop logic with a direct calculation (index - count) will correctly derive the final dimension index.

This is a classic correction of an algorithmic procedure rather than a missing guard (Checking) or a simple constant initialization (Assignment/Initialization).
evidence_used: The fix_diff_oracle shows the removal of a while-loop and its replacement with a direct subtraction: indices[last] = index - count;
